primary_audit.treatment: AUDITED_NOT_ADOPTED — HQ203 recalibration records the audit as high-value documentary evidence, not an automatic adoption decision.

allowed_dispositions_considered.rejected_because: It would overstate coverage. Three exact gaps are named and evidenced: (a) the objective feedback/attractor-prerequisite form is specified as accepted architecture but NOT implemented in the current V556 result schema and has zero positive material; (b) SDTF R4 §9's required 'explicit competent iteration/fixed-point authority' form does not exist anywhere in the current record; (c) the conditional Horizon obligation's lossless representation mapping is unproved. Declaring exhaustive coverage would convert these into 'instance serving debt', which is not what they are.

Directly falsified by the lost-capability test: zero exact terminally necessary functions were found unrepresentable or accidentally retired. All six same-grain retirements are reasoned and preserve their function.

The HQD-125 §15 reopen test fails at its first two conjuncts for every objective prerequisite: each has lawful current representation and a named owner. TD-R03 and its integration ruling independently accept V556 architecture (V556_ARCHITECTURE_TERMINAL_DEMAND_READY = PASS) and block only implementation on named authority preconditions — the definition of bounded implementation debt, not an architecture gap.

Forensics were sufficient for the commissioned question. All seventeen objective prerequisites were traced to exact current owners, authority forms and positive-material status via exact git-object reads. H-A/H-B/H-C/H-D remain open but are other nodes' questions, explicitly flagged by the commission as possibly unresolved and to be handled with conditional contracts rather than guessed.

world_container_question.commission_question: Test whether a persistent world container is actually necessary.
world_container_question.basis: Independent convergence of two authorities. HQ203 recalibration §6: 'A persistent universal multi-source temporal world container is not a proved terminal requirement. The terminal burden is coherent objective-world serving with exact use/selection/transformation/currentness/replay promises.' The audited report reaches the same conclusion: 'A universal persistent world container is not a proved requirement... A coherent service can be composed from exact products if its complete use/selection/transformation promises are specified and qualified.' Every objective prerequisite in this census is carried by immutable exact refs and generic serving carriers, none of which requires a persistent container. The container question therefore does not bear on any H-E prerequisite and is not a residual H-E gap; it remains governed by the H-A/H-D world-contract reconciliation.
world_container_question.qualification: This answers only whether a container is required to PRESERVE the objective prerequisites. It does not decide the separate H-D question of the licensed world->F8 semantic operation.
